name.label: Name
name.description: The name of the device as used by the operating system for identification purposes on the local network.

devicePlatform.label: Operating system -> Platform
devicePlatform.description: The software platform composed of a collection of operating system families providing access to the same objects, activities, events and properties.

deviceManufacturer.label: Hardware -> Manufacturer
deviceManufacturer.description: The short name of the device manufacturer.

hardwareType.label: Hardware -> Device type
hardwareType.description:
The device form factor:
 • desktop
 • laptop
 • virtual

biosSerialNumber.label: Hardware -> BIOS serial number
biosSerialNumber.description: The serial number of the motherboard.

deviceLastSeen.label: Last seen
deviceLastSeen.description: The date and time of the last device activity received by the Nexthink instance.

operatingSystemName.label: Operating system -> Name
operatingSystemName.description: The combination of the name, version and architecture (when applicable) of the operating system.

operatingSystemLastUpdate.label: Operating system -> Last system update
operatingSystemLastUpdate.description: The date and time of the last system update.

cpus.label: CPU
cpus.description: The list of CPU model names and their nominal clock speeds.

memory.label: Hardware -> Installed memory
memory.description: The total amount of random-access memory (RAM) installed on the device.

membershipType.label: Membership type
membershipType.description:
The type of computer group membership. Possible values:
 • standalone
 • workgroup
 • domain
 • open directory

groupName.label: Group name
groupName.description: The name of the security group containing the device when joined to a domain or workgroup.

adSite.label: AD site
adSite.description: Indicates the site to which the device is assigned in the Active Directory (AD).

distinguishedName.label: Distinguished name
distinguishedName.description: The unique identifier of a device when joined to a domain or workgroup.

lastFullBootTime.label: Last full boot time
lastFullBootTime.description: The date and time of the device last boot following a restart or a complete shutdown.

lastConnectivityType.label: Connectivity type
lastConnectivityType.description:
The type of the last used network adapter. Possible values are:
 • WiFi
 • Ethernet
 • Bluetooth

lastLocalIP.label: Connectivity -> Local IP
lastLocalIP.description: The last local IP address for the primary physical network adapter of the device.

locationType.label: Location type
locationType.description: The type of location indicates whether the device is onsite or remote.
